items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Hands Off Jessup Power Plant Control As Data Center Demand Climbs
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) has agreed to sell a majority stake in the Jessup power plant to Equinor, transferring control of the asset from a BlackRock subsidiary. The deal comes as electricity demand from regional data centers rises and pushes utilities and investors to secure dependable power sources.
